title: Logos 34 opening: Spirit texts: God dwelling is Spirit indwelling
english: Thirty-fourth discourse. Sequence of texts showing the Spirit is God, shares the Son’s energy, and that when God is said to dwell in us it is the Spirit who indwells.
Indwelling and power lemmas keep the Spirit with Father and Son, not alien to their essence.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
